ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ فِي الْآخِرِيْنَ ،
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `ala Ālihī fī ‘l-Ākhirīna,
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family among those of new,

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ فِيْ كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَحِيْنٍ ،
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `ala Ālihī fī kulli Waqtin wa Ḥīnin,
en: and send prayers upon, and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family in every instant and interval,

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ فِي الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ ،
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `ala Ālihī, fī ‘l-Mala’i ‘l-A`lā ilā Yawmi ‘d-Dīn,
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family in the Highest Assembly until the Day of Judgement,
